composition_subtypes.role: Coordinate compression and indexed ordering of volumes
DP on DAG to compute min extra space and count optimal chains

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort volumes to build a DAG; DP on indices finds min extra space and counts optimal nestings.
payload.rationale: Sorting discretizes volumes and creates a linear order; DP over that order acts as DAG shortest path and counting, combining two distinct algorithm families.
